args.command: echo '=== updater service ==='; systemctl status zen-ops-updater.service --no-pager --full 2>&1 || true; echo '=== updater journal ==='; journalctl -u zen-ops-updater.service -n 80 --no-pager 2>&1 || true; echo '=== control remote ==='; git -C /var/lib/zen-ops/control.git remote -v 2>&1 || true; git -C /var/lib/zen-ops/control.git config --show-origin --get-all credential.helper 2>&1 || true; echo '=== runtime remote ==='; git -C /opt/zen/zen-ops-runtime remote -v 2>&1 || true; git -C /opt/zen/zen-ops-runtime config --show-origin --get-all credential.helper 2>&1 || true; echo '=== dedicated gh store ==='; test -f /var/lib/zen-ops/gh/hosts.yml && echo DEDICATED_GH_STORE=YES || echo DEDICATED_GH_STORE=NO; echo 'MA2_WRITES=0'; echo 'MA3_WRITES=0'

meta.summary: Diagnose recovered worker versus stalled updater private-repo auth
